title: Amendment No. 3, Agreement for Architectural Services – Hibser Yamauchi Architects, Inc. – Fremont High School Modernization Project – Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Amendment No. 3, Agreement for Architectural Services by and between the District and Hibser Yamauchi Architects, Inc., Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide additional architectural and engineering design services, which include conducting a feasibility study, replacing the mechanical system, and upgrading the HVAC system for the Fremont High School  Modernization Project, in an additional total amount of $53,900.00, increasing not-to-exceed amount of the Agreement from $541,700.00 to $595,600.00.  All other terms and conditions of the Agreement remain in full force and effect.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Adds $53,900 to Hibser Yamauchi's architect contract for Fremont High's HVAC and mechanical upgrades
summary: This amendment adds $53,900.00 to the architectural services contract with Hibser Yamauchi Architects for the Fremont High School modernization project. The added work covers a feasibility study, replacing the mechanical system and upgrading the heating and air-conditioning (HVAC) system. The not-to-exceed amount rises from $541,700.00 to $595,600.00.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
